records.title: Typographic structure
records.summary: Use type scale, measure, weight, and spacing to create hierarchy; reserve display behavior for real editorial moments.

records.title: Quiet precision
records.summary: Favor exact labels, deliberate alignment, restrained color, and visible state for consequential or data-dense work.

records.title: Product as evidence
records.summary: Let believable product UI, real workflow detail, and contextual annotation carry the visual identity.

records.title: Content-led composition
records.summary: Give source material, photography, artwork, or listings enough space to establish identity; keep controls legible and secondary.

records.title: Place and material
records.summary: Use locally meaningful imagery, color, texture, and language only when supported by the actual place, service, or assets.

records.title: Playful utility
records.summary: Use expressive details to reward exploration while keeping task controls, status, and accessibility predictable.
